---
title: "‘Australian of the Year’ as Contrarian Sell Signal"
date: "2014-01-31"
categories: ["Financial Markets"]
---

In January 2010, The Australian named then Prime Minister Kevin Rudd as ‘Australian of the Year’ ‘because of the way he dealt with the global financial crisis’. From affiliate EWI’s 2014 [State of the Global Markets Report](http://www.elliottwave.com/r.asp?rcn=affem&acn=4ie&url=/club/State-of-the-Global-Markets.aspx?code=84421):

> *We correctly called the award a sell signal for Australian stocks - the All Ords would make no net progress for the next three-and-a-half years.*
